title: How I Beat General Velgar in RuneScape Dragonwilds 1.0
author: GamerCory
description:
How I beat General Velgar, the Green Dragon boss, in RuneScape Dragonwilds 1.0.

This was my first time fighting General Velgar, and I went into the encounter without knowing exactly what to expect. In this video, I'll show you the gear and preparation I used, how I handled the fight, the attacks and mechanics I encountered, and the strategy that ultimately worked for me.

General Velgar is encountered during the Dragon Slayer progression after crafting the Challenge Horn using Dragon Teeth, Bloodwood Sap, and Bronze Bars.

If you're getting ready to fight the Green Dragon yourself, hopefully seeing exactly how I beat General Velgar will help you prepare for your own attempt.

I've also made separate RuneScape Dragonwilds 1.0 guides covering Dragon Teeth, Bloodwood Sap, Bronze Bars, and other resources you'll need as you progress through the game.

More RuneScape Dragonwilds 1.0 guides as I progress through the game — subscribe if you want quick guides without wasting your time.

transcript.text: This is my first attempt ever at trying to defeat the green dragon. So, I thought I had everything that I possibly
could have in order to actually accomplish this fight. But my biggest downfall was that I just started using
ma magic. And unfortunately, I'm using air here and he's weak to water. So, that's already a bad start right there.
And honestly, my magic power is kind of weak, but I have the best possible staff that I could have during this entire
fight. But I'm just going to showcase most of it as I as I go and I'll jump in from time to time and just let you know
when things kind of come up. But I thought I had enough food. I thought I had enough potions. But the one thing
that I will mention before I actually be quiet for a little bit is don't craft the lesser of the anti- poison potions.
They're the ingredients and what you actually have to do with this fight because you're going to get poison quite
often. just use the cheapest the weak anti-poison as much as possible. That way, you're not actually
trying to overcome it. And you can see that during some of the footage that's going on right now, I I don't even know
that I could actually use my anti-poison to go ahead and stop it. I realized it during a later portion of the video, but
you can see all the mechanics are actually relatively easy. It's most basically use an anti-poison potion to
get out of the poison. Stay away from the big poison balls and make sure that you're staying away from his claws when
he sends them down. Now, as the fight gets going on further, he changes it up just slightly. the the more claws that
come at you become more. Like he starts out with one, then he goes to two, then he goes to three, then he goes to four,
and then the poison is about the same, but the the poison that gets dropped down with the circles gets more
extensive later on. And you can see that he pretty much just killed me right off
the bat. So, I go back to the base and I kind of think about what I want to do. Now, I do have a better um long bow that
I found, and I wish I could remember where I found it, but it is like the purplish item. So, I decided I'm going
to use that with my bronze arrows. And then I decided that I was going to craft up a lesser option for the focus attack
potion since that does grant me 15% XP boost for every attack skill. So, I'm going to get more XP for actually doing
a little bit of damage. Now, the one thing that I probably should have done is looked at my actual skills to see if
I had something going on with any kind of attack so that I could actually go ahead and become a little bit stronger
for the specific fight. But anyway, enjoy the rest of the fight. First time I died, you can figure out the rest
going on. And I'm going to be quiet. Hopefully you guys enjoy the rest of the video. And if you guys do, make sure
that you guys go and like, comment, and subscribe down below. It does help me out a lot and is greatly appreciated.
and I will see you in the next video. But please stick around to the end of this video. I would appreciate it.

comments.author: @MrLowandpro
comments.text: Combat tip. Dodge roll has huge i-frames. Also very generous window. The infusion to reduce dodge roll is actually so much stronger than anything else. I never played early access and went straight to hard mode. Died lots of times to everything and anything, and took a long time to learn that dodge roll is king. You can't be greedy with attacks. Save enough stamina for at least one, or two, dodge rolls and never commit a full combo on enemies you're not familiar with. Haven't died since entering third map.
